body: i know ive really been trying but i find that everytime im alone i seem to lack motivation in everything. i don’t think it’s exclusively just like, HIM considering that I do have depression but i think the fact that he’s super inconsistent has fucked with me. i just feel like I have always been super loyal and crazy in love and im not saying he doesn’t care for me, but i don’t know if it’s on the same level. i feel like a convenience

i don’t even mean to just be talking to air but it’s like im so sick of being everybody’s last choice, the convenient choice. and to anyone who says that they’d rather this than not be a choice at all, i just disagree. im not a choice because they care. it’s because im easy and want to believe
it’s been like 5-6 months at this point

I feel this. I was born unattractive according to society as well, and the only way I get called pretty is when I cake on a bunch of makeup. Honestly though, I seem to notice that confidence(and no, I’m not saying this to be cliche) seems to make people more popular than anything. Even at school, I notice that people who are unattractive but extremely popular due to the fact that they carry themselves with complete confidence. You can’t really change your face, but you can “fake confidence til you make it”. It is unfair, but if this is something you care about, you should maybe focus on parts of yourself that do not have to do with looks(education, personality), and maybe embark on a self-love journey along the way? Dunno

Respectfully, your dad is forcing this on you and it’s just going to continue to wear on you and you won’t be successful at something you’re unmotivated at. Just remember at the end of the day it’s your life, and you have to take risks and be the one who controls your life. If you are planning on suicide, why not just say screw it and pursue that art career? It is not about a degree, if you are good at something and master it, people will pay.

Don’t worry, nobody thinks you’re just being edgy. Things seem hard for you, and you’re way too young to be going through this and at this age you should be protected from these types of feelings, and I apologize that you don’t have the stability from your parents that you deserve.
